patternHint: Numeric duration expressions in Hindi typically follow the pattern <number> <unit> से (se), e.g. 'teen din se' (since 3 days), 'do mahine se' (since 2 months). The matcher below extracts the leading number/word-number, the unit, and normalizes to {value, unit}.
notes: This is a starter pattern set covering the most common phrasing. It will not catch every dialectal variant — extend as real transcripts surface new patterns, and never silently invent an exact calendar date when the patient only gave a relative duration.
